# WAS_KCCA { #wass2s.WAS_KCCA }

```python
WAS_KCCA(
    n_modes=4,
    kernel='linear',
    dist_method='nonparam',
    standardize=True,
    cv_folds=3,
    random_state=42,
    search_method='grid',
    reg=1e-06,
    pca_explained_variance=0.8,
    pca_min_components=None,
    pca_whiten=False,
    pca_backend='xeofs',
    pca_use_coslat=False,
    pca_solver='auto',
)
```
